audience: finance and operations teams that extract fields from scanned documents with Nanonets

useCases.title: Extract fields from a short document
useCases.text: Run a Nanonets OCR model on one public https file of up to 3 pages, and read the predicted fields and tables. Each run uses credits.

useCases.title: Queue a long document for extraction
useCases.text: Queue a file of more than 3 pages for extraction, and keep its request_file_id to read the result later.

useCases.title: Read the result of a queued file
useCases.text: Get the initial prediction, the reviewer changes and the final result of one file by its request_file_id.

useCases.title: Review a day of predictions
useCases.text: List the page predictions a model made over a date range, then read one page with its values and scores.
